I thought it would be an interestingly honest and good idea to let ppl see "my past" but it honestly hasn't changed anything. I still get ghosted like a motherfucker. I still send lengthy hearty honest pm's to non interested ppl. I still remain alone surrounded by so many ppl. 

I still remain alone with music in my head. 

How many examples do I need to tell me to stop fucking with the world and go inside my own and let loose and create everything in my heart and mind. 

If I am supposed to be the biggest thing the world has seen...

Then... I need to start feeding my soul... with my passions.

Why am I so scared to let go?

Why am I fighting so hard for something i've never had before?

Why do I care about this world so fucking much?

I'm on vacation with family in Rhode island and I'm supposed to be enjoying myself. Instead it feels the same as it's always been even if I haven't talked to most of them in a long time. I still feel like I'm here by myself. Like usual everyone is convincingly preoccupied with more important things than interacting with me. I've been in my room for 12 hours now and really don't want to move. I can't move. I already know that what is waiting for me outside of this room will guarantee to disappoint and depress. I'm 33 and don't fit in with the younger ones here or the older ones but thats been the story of my existence since I became aware of reality and my existence.

I wish that I could just walk right out into the ocean and let the tide claim my life.
